description: Invented users that fill an app's back office for screenshots or a demo, best in env "pre": no account, no mail, emails @ejemplo.neblla.app, outside quotas, broadcasts and exports. "create" returns their id; "removeAll" deletes them (in that env) with everything they did (do it before going public). The other actions act as them: "buy" is a sample sale with no money (it gives the product), "score" passes the real checks (a refused one flags them), "save" replaces their whole save. Never for real users. More: neblla_get_llms tools/sample_users

action.description: What to do. By action: create {name, email?, photo?, language?}; update {user, name?, email?, photo?, language?}; remove {user}; book {user, set, slot, for?, party?}; buy {user, productId, amount?, at?, until?, series?}; message {user, text}; chat {user, set, slot, text}; score {user, board, value, seconds?, day?, data?}; save {user, data}…

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

at.description: buy: when they bought (ISO date in the last year; default now).

data.description: score: what the board's check receives; save: their whole save.

day.description: score: YYYY-MM-DD, up to 30 days back.

email.description: create / update: …@ejemplo.neblla.app; left out: made from the name.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

for.description: book: who the place is for.

photo.description: create / update: an https picture; null removes it.

seconds.description: score: how long the game took (default 60).

series.description: buy: which repetition of a standing place.

site.description: rate: the site of the session.

team.description: book: the side of a match, "A" or "B".

text.description: message / chat / rate: what they write.

until.description: buy: a subscription ends then (ISO date).

user.description: The sample user's id (create returns it).
